title: Signal: Build backend requirement with no version constraint
scope: A pyproject.toml file that declares a build requirement that names only the package.
limitations: It matches a build requirement that names only the package in the parsed pyproject.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pyproject.toml that mentions a build requirement that names only the package in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
